title: Pride
extract:
Pride is  Sirius' signature Heavy Scythe. The weapon gains increased Status Chance upon hitting enemies with a Slam Attack.

Characteristics
This weapon deals equal  Puncture and  Slash damage.
Slam attacks grant the Coronal Ejection buff, increasing Status Chance by 15% (additive to mods such as  Melee Prowess) per enemy enemy hit, stacking up to 10 times for 150% additional Status Chance. Lasts 10 seconds and can be refreshed.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High total damage (250)
High damage × attack speed (345)
Very high block angle (65°)
Very high attack speed (1.200x animation speed)
High attack range (2.80 m)
High status chance (35.00%)
Above average crit multiplier (2.00x)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
High total damage (500)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Very high block angle (65°)
Above average damage × attack speed (575)
High attack range (2.80 m)
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
High total damage (750)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Very high block angle (65°)
Above average damage × attack speed (862.5)
High attack range (2.80 m)
Disadvantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Low crit chance (15.00%)
Very low follow through (0.4x)
Very low disposition (●○○○○ (0.50x))
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Low crit chance (15.00%)

Very low disposition (●○○○○ (0.50x))
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)

See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.
Comparisons:

 Pride (Normal Attack), compared to  Wrath (Normal Attack):
Higher base damage (250.00 vs. 220.00)
Higher  Puncture damage ( 125 vs.  44)
Lower  Slash damage ( 125 vs.  176)
Higher total damage (250 vs. 220)
Lower base critical chance (15.00% vs. 30.00%)
Higher base status chance (35.00% vs. 15.00%)

Acquisition
Pride's main and component blueprints can be obtained from The Kuva Wytch, Uranus Proxima, as well as a  Wrath Blade from Scoria's Angel. Access requires completion of Jade Shadows: Constellations.
Alternatively Pride and the Wrath Blade's blueprints can be purchased from Pontis Tower with  Emerald Talent and  Crimson Talent, awarded from The Kuva Wytch and Scoria's Angel respectively in quantities of 12-16 (18-22 on The Steel Path) from mission completion plus shooting down targets from the Owowyrm/Ramsled minigame. Each component requires 45 and the main blueprint requires 90, totaling 180  Emerald Talent and 45  Crimson Talent for the whole set.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.

Notes

Trivia
Pride and  Wrath share the exact same design, with the only difference being which end is pointing upwards (in Pride's case, the green end associated with Sirius).
